meta.title: OpenAI Codex Sign-in
meta.description: Sign in with ChatGPT and use OpenAI Codex in DSH.

tools.loginStarted: ChatGPT sign-in for OpenAI Codex has started.
tools.loginInstructions: Ask the user to open the verification URL and enter the device code. After authorization, call codex_status to confirm sign-in.
tools.loginTimedOut: The device code took too long to arrive. Try signing in again.
tools.checkStatus: Ask the user to complete authorization, then check again.
tools.notLoggedIn: You are signed out. Call codex_login to sign in with ChatGPT.
tools.signInExpires: The token expires at {date} and refreshes automatically.
tools.logoutFailed: Could not clear the local OpenAI Codex credential. Try signing out again.
tools.providerNotSignedIn: OpenAI Codex is signed out. Open Settings → OpenAI Codex and sign in.
tools.loginFailed: Could not complete OpenAI Codex sign-in. Try again.
tools.refreshSignInFailed: Could not refresh your OpenAI Codex sign-in. Try signing in again.
tools.verificationUrlMissing: OpenAI did not return a device verification URL.
tools.verificationUrlInvalid: OpenAI returned an invalid device verification URL.
tools.verificationUrlUntrusted: The device verification URL is outside OpenAI’s sign-in service.
tools.proxyUnavailable: The Windows manual HTTP/HTTPS proxy is unavailable. Configure a manual proxy or follow DSH’s proxy settings.
